title: Red Coloring Linked to Cancer Risk Banned in US Foods
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has banned a chemical widely used to color some food products red.
sentences.zh: 美国食品药品管理局(FDA)禁止一种广泛用于给某些食品涂红的化学品。

sentences.en: The ban of the coloring chemical, called dye, came nearly 35 years after it was removed from skin products because of a possible cancer risk.
sentences.zh: 由于可能存在癌症风险,从皮肤产品中去除这种染色化学物质(称为染色)已近35年。

sentences.en: A group of food safety and health supporters issued a petition in 2022 seeking to have the FDA ban Red No.
sentences.zh: 一群食品安全和卫生支持者于2022年发出请愿书,要求林业发展局禁止红色编号。

sentences.en: 3 in food. The earlier ban was ordered in 1990, after two studies showed Red No.
sentences.zh: 早先的禁令是在1990年下令的,经过两次研究发现Red No.

sentences.en: 3 caused cancer in male rats eating high levels of the chemical.
sentences.zh: 3 导致雄性大鼠患高浓度的癌症。

sentences.en: At the time, however, the FDA only acted to ban the coloring mixture in products put on the skin or in drugs taken by mouth.
sentences.zh: 然而,当时,林业发展局只是采取行动,禁止在涂在皮肤上的产品或口服毒品中的染色混合物。

sentences.en: Health activists had long sought FDA approval to expand the ban to food products.
sentences.zh: 卫生活动家长期以来一直寻求林业发展局批准扩大对食品的禁令。

sentences.en: In November, nearly two dozen members of Congress sent a letter demanding that FDA officials ban Red No.
sentences.zh: 11月,将近20多名国会议员发函要求林业发展局官员禁止红色No。

sentences.en: 3. Some of the most common products containing Red No.
sentences.zh: 3. 一些最常用的产品,含有红色编号。

sentences.en: 3 include sweets, icing, strawberry milk, maraschino cherries, strawberry protein drinks, as well as some gummy vitamins and medications.
sentences.zh: 3种包括糖果、冰淇淋、草莓牛奶、马拉希诺樱桃、草莓蛋白质饮料,以及一些甜食维生素和药物。

sentences.en: The FDA said food manufacturers will have until January 2027 to remove the dye from their products.
sentences.zh: 林业发展局说,食品制造商要到2027年1月才能从产品中去除染料。

sentences.en: Other countries still permit certain uses of the dye.
sentences.zh: 其他国家仍然允许染料的某些用途。

sentences.en: But any imported products will still have to meet the new U.S. requirement.
sentences.zh: 但任何进口产品仍必须满足美国的新要求。

sentences.en: Red No. 3 is already banned for food use in Europe, Australia and New Zealand, except in certain kinds of cherries.
sentences.zh: 欧洲、澳大利亚和新西兰已经禁止红色第3号用于食品,但某些种类的樱桃除外。

sentences.en: The dye will be banned in California starting in January 2027.
sentences.zh: 从2027年1月开始 加利福尼亚州将禁止染色

sentences.en: And lawmakers in Tennessee, Arkansas and Indiana have also proposed limits on certain dyes, especially from foods offered in public schools.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州、阿肯色州和印第安纳州的立法者也提议限制某些染料,特别是公立学校提供的食物。

sentences.en: Jim Jones is the FDA's deputy commissioner for human foods.
sentences.zh: Jim Jones是食品药品管理局主管人类食物的副局长

sentences.en: 3 causes cancer in male rats does not occur in humans." FDA officials said the ban was enacted because of a U.S. rule called the Delaney Clause.
sentences.zh: 3 导致雄性大鼠的癌症不会发生在人类身上。 食品药品管理局官员说,禁令的颁布是因为美国的一项规则,即德莱尼条款。

sentences.en: This legal policy requires the FDA to ban any additive found to cause cancer in people or animals.
sentences.zh: 这项法律政策要求林业发展局禁止任何导致人或动物癌症的添加剂。
